Project Instructions
Marketing website for Brain of bike a UK built app in progress. The maintainer is a novice.
Keep replies and command output short.
Make the smallest change that solves the request. Don't refactor or add unnecessary complexity.
Reuse existing patterns and prefer content edits.
For simple requests, act directly. Don't investigate unrelated files or run unnecessary commands.
Start with the most likely file and stop investigating once you have enough information.
If a task is easier for the user to do manually than for you to investigate and change, give exact copy/paste instructions instead.
If unclear, ask one short question.
Don't modify infrastructure unless requested.
Don't run the build unless requested.
Text changes
Change only the requested text.
Preserve surrounding markup, classes, styling and SVGs.
Don't replace whole sections for small changes.
